title: Test: a piece from the catalogue

blocks.text:
## Test lesson
A placeholder for checking the app, not teaching: its step names a piece from the catalogue ("Mary Had A Little Lamb", a CC0 upload to MuseScore), which opening the step adds to your library if it is not there yet. Nothing here says anything about the music.

blocks.title: Test: a catalogue piece, bars 1–4
blocks.about: Test: the piece comes from the catalogue; the first time, opening the step adds it to Music.
